pullRequest.body:
This intentionally constructed demonstration moves category aggregation from model construction into each read. The queries retain their results while the implementation changes from a precomputed index to scanning the same 10,000-event workload.

The pull_request workflow benchmarks the exact base and head commits with the same Java/JMH harness, three fresh forks per case/arm, three warmups and five measured iterations, alternating arm order across fork blocks. It publishes actual raw observations and execution diagnostics for protected import into RegressLab. No production traffic, invented timings, statistical significance, or inferred root cause is claimed.

Validation: the baseline Maven/JMH build, local executed JMH raw-output check, producer tests, and event-query correctness checks passed. Actions supplies the end-to-end measurements.
